output.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS order_year,
         SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue
  FROM marts.fct_orders
  WHERE is_revenue
    AND order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END), 2) AS revenue_2024_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 2) AS revenue_2025_eur,
       ROUND(
         (SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END))
         / SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM yearly
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue from orders with is_revenue = true (status completed), grouped by calendar year of order_date (fiscal year = calendar year). Growth percent = (2025 revenue - 2024 revenue) / 2024 revenue * 100, rounded to 2 decimals. The query also returns both yearly revenue totals so the growth can be checked.
